items.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
items.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
items.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
items.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.

detailZh: 韩泰或加入F1轮胎供应合同竞标
倍耐力将在明年F1招标程序开启时面临来自世界拉力锦标赛轮胎供应商以及普利司通的竞争
韩泰是世界拉力锦标赛的独家轮胎供应商
这是F1全球影响力和人气持续增长的又一鲜明例证：又一家有实力的竞争者出现，竞标其独家轮胎供应合同。
倍耐力于2011年接替普利司通成为F1唯一轮胎供应商，在其头十年的大部分时间里，当续约时刻到来时，它几乎未遇到任何有组织的挑战。近年来情况发生了变化。普利司通在2010年以成本及全球金融危机后的“战略调整”为由退出F1后，在2023年最近一次招标过程中重新参与竞标，并且据了解正在为下一次招标准备提案。
如今，Motorsport.com获悉，世界拉力锦标赛的独家轮胎供应商韩泰正在为明年启动的、涵盖2028年后F1时代的招标流程组建竞标团队。该公司曾在2018年竞标2020-23年的合同但未成功，该合同随后因疫情延长了一年。
倍耐力目前的合同期为2025-28年，因为该公司——与FIA和F1一起——去年6月共同行使了一年续约选择权。在上一次招标过程中，本赛季向新规则过渡期间的技术稳定性被认为尤为重要。鉴于2030年即将到来的变化，潜在竞标者必须向FIA保证他们能够实现这一点。
韩泰已经在F1大奖赛周末中扮演过一个小角色，曾在2021年和2022年担任W系列赛的供应商。这家韩国公司涉足赛车运动已超过三十年，期间曾多次担任DTM的独家供应商，以及地区性F3和F4系列赛的供应商。2022至2026年，它为Formula E的Gen3时代赛车提供轮胎，之后普利司通接过了该合同。
韩泰竞赛部门首席执行官右——图中他与现代汽车的Andrew Wheatley一同出现在日本拉力赛上——在过去两个赛季中已到访过多场大奖赛，与F1相关方会面。
2025年，它被任命为世界拉力锦标赛的独家轮胎供应商；今年，它又被国际汽联指定为该管理机构‘全球合作伙伴计划’的成员。
包括韩泰竞赛部门首席执行官Steven Cho在内的代表们，在过去两个赛季中已出席过多场大奖赛，最近一次是上周末在拉斯维加斯；据了解，该公司已经用一辆基于F2的‘骡车’进行了原型轮胎测试。
近年来，该公司已为国际汽联（FIA）的两项重大世界锦标赛提供轮胎，并与管理机构建立了更紧密的联系，这将使其此次申办比上一次更具可信度。电动方程式（Formula E）是一张强有力的名片，因为其环保目标要求仅使用两种不同的轮胎配方，且均由可持续材料制成。在上一次招标过程中，可持续性是倍耐力的制胜一招，因为该公司承诺从2024年起为F1引入经森林管理委员会认证的轮胎。
尽管总部位于韩国，韩泰在德国汉诺威设有研发设施，并在匈牙利拥有一家工厂，目前该工厂正在进行4.5亿欧元的扩建。倍耐力在其位于土耳其伊兹米特的工厂生产包括F1轮胎在内的赛车运动产品，与普通公路轮胎同线生产。
任何进入招标过程的公司都面临重大挑战，因为它将在当前技术规则实施的第四年才进入，因此必须提出非常有说服力的理由，证明其至少能与现有产品匹敌。尽管倍耐力的轮胎多年来经常受到批评，但这是独家供应性质所决定的。
当前的轮胎需要满足一套复杂且往往相互矛盾的要求：它们必须在热性能和结构上足够坚固，同时具有可预测的退化曲线，以促进观赏性和策略多样性。过去15年的经验表明，很容易在任一方向上过犹不及。
国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏拉耶姆在6月宣布续约时表示：“倍耐力多年来一直是国际汽联F1世界锦标赛的重要合作伙伴，在我们这项运动的最高水平上持续提供高标准的表现、创新和安全性。续约至2028年底为锦标赛提供了稳定性。”
这一点，再加上倍耐力品牌在赛道周围的普遍存在，清楚地描绘了任何竞标者必须提供的东西：雄厚的财力，以及一种保证——当他们的轮胎装上时，除了胎侧上的名字之外，没有人会注意到任何区别。
detailEn: Hankook tipped to enter race for F1 tyre supply contract
Pirelli is set to face competition from World Rally Championship tyre supplier as well as Bridgestone when the Formula 1 tender process opens next year
Hankook is sole tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship
It's another vivid demonstration of Formula 1's ever-growing global reach and popularity that another serious contender has emerged to bid for its exclusive tyre-supply contract.

Pirelli took over from Bridgestone as F1's sole tyre supplier in 2011 and for much of its first decade it faced little in the way of concerted challenge when renewal time rolled around. That has changed in recent years. Having walked away from F1 in 2010, citing costs and a "strategic realignment" following the global financial crisis, Bridgestone threw its hat in the ring during the most recent tender process in 2023, and is known to be preparing a pitch for the next one.

Now Motorsport.com understands that Hankook, exclusive tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship, is assembling a bid for the tender process which opens next year for the post-2028 F1 era. It was previously an unsuccessful bidder in 2018 for the contract covering 2020-23, which was then extended by a year owing to the pandemic.

Pirelli's current contract runs from 2025-28, since the company – along with the FIA and F1 – mutually exercised a one-year extension clause last June. During the last tender process, technical stability during the transition to a new formula this season was regarded as a particularly important. Given the impending changes in 2030, potential bidders will have to assure the FIA they can achieve this.

While the FIA assesses tenders based on the bidder's technical capacity, sustainability credentials, and the operational capacity to manage the supply process seamlessly, F1 also has a voice in the final decision on commercial grounds. Pirelli is a conspicuously big spender on trackside signage as well as facilitating VIP perks such as the ‘Hot Laps' programme.

Hankook has already played a small role in grand prix weekends as a supplier to the W Series in 2021 and 2022. The South Korean company has been involved in motor racing for over three decades, at various times being exclusive supplier to the DTM, along with regional F3 and F4 series. It supplied Formula E's Gen3-era cars from 2022-26 before Bridgestone took on that contract.
Hankook Competition CEO Steven Cho (right), seen here with Hyundai's Andrew Wheatley on Rally Japan, has visited several grands prix to meet F1 stakeholders over the past two seasons
It was appointed sole tyre supplier of the World Rally Championship in 2025 and this year it was named by the FIA as a member of the governing body's ‘global partner programme'.

Representatives including Hankook Competition CEO Steven Cho have attended several grands prix over the past two seasons, most recently last weekend in Las Vegas, and it's understood the company has already conducted testing of prototype tyres with an F2-based ‘mule car'.

Having supplied two major FIA world championships in recent years, along with establishing much closer ties with the governing body, it would make this a much more credible bid than the previous one. Formula E is a strong calling card since its environmental aims call for just two different tyre compounds, both made from sustainable materials. Sustainability was Pirelli's finishing move in the last tender process, since it undertook to introduce Forest Stewardship Council-certified tyres to F1 from 2024 onwards.

Although based in South Korea, Hankook has an R&D facility in Hanover, Germany, and a factory in Hungary currently undergoing a €450million expansion in Hungary. Pirelli makes its motorsport products, including the F1 tyres, alongside regular road tyres in its factory in Izmit, Turkey.

Any company entering the tender process faces a significant challenge because it will be bidding to arrive in year four of the current technical regulations, so it would have to build a very convincing case that it could at least match the existing product. While Pirelli's tyres have come in for regular criticism over the years, this is in the nature of having exclusivity.

The current tyres are expected to deliver on a complex and often contradictory set of requirements: they must be thermally and structurally robust, but with a predictable degradation curve to facilitate the spectacle and strategic variety. Experience of the past 15 years demonstrates how easy it is to overshoot either way.
Hankook was Formula E's supplier through the Gen 3 era so, besides single-seater experience, it is accustomed to the kind of trackside signage deals that come with the territory

"Pirelli has been an important partner to the FIA F1 world championship for many years, providing a consistently high standard of performance, innovation and safety at the highest level of our sport," said FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem when the contact extension was announced in June. "This extension through to the end of 2028 provides stability for the championship."

That, along with the prevalence of Pirelli branding around the tracks, paints a clear picture of what any bidder has to offer: deep pockets, and a guarantee that when their tyres go on, nobody will notice any difference apart from the name on the sidewalls.

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔对托托·沃尔夫的看法进行了暗示
乔治·拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯赛后飞行中与托托·沃尔夫开怀大笑，之后暗示了沃尔夫对维斯塔潘的私下看法
对于梅赛德斯车队的粉丝来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析
托托·沃尔夫在过去的一周里对F1最激烈的车手纷争显得不以为意，然而乔治·拉塞尔暗示，沃尔夫在麦克风关闭后看法有所不同
独家接受天空体育F1的马丁·布兰德利采访——在周日卡塔尔大奖赛完整播出之前，采访于周五提前预告——拉塞尔被问及在拉斯维加斯事件后沃尔夫对维斯塔潘的外交性公开立场。拉塞尔没有重复私下对话的内容，但几乎没有疑问，沃尔夫镜头外的评价更加尖锐。
“嗯，我知道他在场外的立场，所以可能不会重复那些话，”拉塞尔说。“托托和我比赛后在拉斯维加斯飞回，我们确实对赛后的一些评论笑了出来。但我们只是知道某些人是如何处理他们的业务的。”
沃尔夫在拉斯维加斯的语气为何引起侧目
这番话直接切入 车队区最受审视的动态之一。自从梅赛德斯在2025年追求红牛车手以来，沃尔夫对维斯塔潘的公开友好态度一直受到密切关注——拉塞尔本人在2025年6月接受天空体育F1采访时确认的谈判推迟了他的合同续签。
即使在2026年3月沃尔夫公开否认了新的谣言后——坚称“目前Max与梅赛德斯的事情还没有定论”，并支持拉塞尔与布拉克利“一直合作到2037年”——沃尔夫和维斯塔潘一起度假的照片在2026年7月再次出现，再次激起了猜测。
上周末在内华达州，这种动态再次受到显微镜般的审视。在最后练习中在14号弯道发生接触后，拉塞尔公开批评了维斯塔潘，而维斯塔潘则通过赢得周六晚上的大奖赛来回应，而拉塞尔在与队友基米·安东内利战斗时撞上护栏，最终排名第九。事后，维斯塔潘宣称拉塞尔“到目前为止水平还远低于我”，并公开表示对对手晚上的错误感到满意。
梅赛德斯AMG Petronas F1车队执行董事沃尔夫、梅赛德斯AMG Petronas F1车队拉塞尔
与沃尔夫的公开反应形成对比的是，他的反应出奇地冷静。沃尔夫称维斯塔潘是一个“当之无愧的赢家”，他“没有犯错误”，并且“总是有回应”，沃尔夫轻描淡写地处理了两人之间的紧张关系。沃尔夫对记者说：“这可能是一点点猫捉老鼠的游戏，”他还补充说，“双方的挑衅是娱乐的另一个好因素”，同时指出在 stewards’ 审判长，里确实发生了一些“交流”。
计时解释了其中一部分限制：沃尔夫最初的赛道旁言论是在旗杆落下后不久发表的，在维斯塔潘最尖锐的新闻发布会挖苦尚未完全传开之前。然而，一位车队负责人赞扬刚刚公开嘲讽他车手的对手，这一行为立即引发了争议——这使得拉塞尔回家的揭示成为了一个尖锐的提醒，表明梅赛德斯内部的团结与公开公关看起来不同。
沃尔夫的私下笑声是否会在最后两轮比赛中转化为赛道上的报复，现在取决于拉塞尔。进入卡塔尔，维斯塔潘以九场领奖台 streak，其中包括四次胜利，在车手积分榜上以304分排名第二 - 比拉塞尔（264分）高出40分，还剩下50分未决。
至少在周五的洛杉矶赛道首节练习中，梅赛德斯以鼓舞人心的速度开始了周末的比赛，冠军候选人安东内利带领银箭车队以1-2的成绩领先，领先于拉塞尔半秒，而维斯塔潘在最后一小时结束时排名第六。将这种早期的速度转化为周日比红牛更出色的结果，将比在回家的航班上所说的任何话更能决定性地解决拉斯维加斯的争议。
detailEn: George Russell drops cryptic hint over where Toto Wolff “stands off the record” on Max Verstappen
George Russell teases Toto Wolff's "off the record" view of Max Verstappen after their post-Las Vegas flight laugh
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Toto Wolff has spent the past week sounding remarkably unfazed by Formula 1’s fiercest driver feud. George Russell, however, just hinted that Mercedes’ team principal sounds rather different once the microphones are switched off.

Speaking exclusively to Martin Brundle for Sky Sports F1 - in an interview previewed Friday ahead of its full broadcast before Sunday’s Qatar Grand Prix - Russell was pressed on Wolff’s diplomatic public stance toward Max Verstappen following their Las Vegas flashpoint. Russell stopped short of repeating private conversations, but left little doubt that Wolff’s off-camera assessment carries a sharper edge.

"Well, I know where he [Wolff] stands off the record, so I won't probably repeat that," Russell said. "Toto and I were flying back after the race in Vegas, and we did have quite a laugh about the comments that were said after the race. But we just know how certain people go about their business."
Why Wolff’s Las Vegas tone raised eyebrows

That remark cuts straight into one of the paddock’s most scrutinised dynamics. Wolff’s public warmth toward Verstappen has been tracked closely ever since Mercedes pursued the Red Bull driver in 2025 - talks Russell himself confirmed to Sky Sports F1 in June 2025 had delayed his own contract renewal.

Even after Wolff publicly shut down fresh rumours in March 2026 - insisting "The Max to Mercedes thing for now is not on" and backing Russell to stay with Brackley "until 2037" - photographs of Wolff and Verstappen holidaying together surfaced again in July 2026, keeping the speculation alive.

Last weekend in Nevada put that dynamic back under the microscope. After final-practice contact at Turn 14 triggered public criticism from Russell, Verstappen answered by winning Saturday night’s Grand Prix while Russell clipped the barrier late while battling team-mate Kimi Antonelli and dropped to ninth. In the aftermath, Verstappen declared Russell "so far below my level" and took open satisfaction in his rival’s late error.
Toto Wolff, Executive Director of Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team, George Russell, Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team

Wolff’s public reaction, by contrast, stayed conspicuously calm. Calling Verstappen "a deserving winner" who "made no mistakes" and "always had a response," Wolff brushed off the tension between the pair. "It's probably been a bit of cat and mouse," Wolff told reporters, adding that "these provocations in either side is another good factor of entertainment" while noting only that there had been "a bit of an exchange" in the stewards’ room.

Timing explains part of that restraint: Wolff’s initial paddock remarks came shortly after the chequered flag, before Verstappen’s sharpest press-conference digs had fully made the rounds. Still, the optics of a team principal praising the rival who had just publicly mocked his driver sparked immediate debate—making Russell’s flight-home reveal a pointed reminder that internal alignment inside Mercedes looks different from public PR.

Whether Wolff’s private laughs translate into on-track payback is now down to Russell over the final two rounds. Entering Qatar, Verstappen rides a nine-race podium streak featuring four wins and sits second in the Drivers’ standings on 304 points - 40 clear of Russell (264) with only 50 points left on the table.

Mercedes at least opened the weekend with encouraging pace in Friday’s opening practice at Losail, where champion-elect Antonelli led a Silver Arrows 1-2 half a second clear of Russell, while Verstappen ended the hour down in sixth. Turning that early speed into a Sunday result ahead of Red Bull would settle the Vegas fallout far more decisively than anything said on a flight home.

detailZh: F1卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛分析：安东内利长距离比维斯塔潘快近一秒
梅赛德斯统治了卡塔尔周五的练习，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利在比赛模拟中平均每圈比最接近的对手快0.83秒
安东内利带着早期热门身份进入2026年F1赛季倒数第二站卡塔尔。这位卫冕世界冠军统治了卢赛尔国际赛道的周五练习，无论单圈还是比赛模拟都表现出色。他在长距离上的优势尤其令人印象深刻：在调整后的长距离分析中，他最接近的挑战者马克斯·维斯塔潘平均每圈慢0.83秒。
安东内利在第一节自由练习中已经做出最快圈，比队友乔治·拉塞尔快0.507秒。梅赛德斯的统治在第二节练习中延续，尽管多次事故和红旗限制了排位模拟的参考价值。
在领先的车队中，只有红牛和迈凯伦成功用软胎完成了飞驰圈。尽管如此，两支车队都未能击败梅赛德斯用中性胎做出的圈速。安东内利以1:23.077的成绩位居榜首，拉塞尔落后略超过十分之一秒半。作为最接近梅赛德斯双雄的挑战者，兰多·诺里斯已经落后近半秒。
在比赛模拟中，竞争格局更加明显。在计入轮胎配方和 连续圈数长度的差异后，安东内利成为场上轻松最快的车手。即便是拉塞尔，平均每圈也比队友慢0.90秒。
为什么梅赛德斯在卡塔尔如此强势？
梅赛德斯优势之大尤其值得注意，因为这支车队传统上并不以在周五练习中释放赛车全部潜力而闻名。厂队通常采取相当保守的策略，尤其是在引擎性能方面。
虽然不能完全排除练习数据中存在燃油量和引擎设置的差异，但梅赛德斯一贯的做法让人有理由相信，其优势反映了真实的基础速度，尽管这一优势的幅度仍不确定。
相反，仔细观察各计时段的时间，可以为梅赛德斯的优势所在提供一些线索。这支世界冠军车队在第一和第三计时段明显快于对手，这两个计时段都以中高速弯道为特点。
在开场的第一计时段，梅赛德斯对其最接近的挑战者红牛拥有约0.3秒的优势。在最后的第三计时段，梅赛德斯对迈凯伦取得约0.25秒的优势，对红牛则多达0.4秒——尽管对手使用的是更软的轮胎配方。
只有在第二计时段，红牛和迈凯伦才能与梅赛德斯匹敌。然而，软胎很可能在赛道的这一区段带来特别优势，因为这里更紧、更慢的弯道对牵引力提出了更高的要求。
红牛还是迈凯伦：谁将成为梅赛德斯最接近的挑战者？
在梅赛德斯身后，红牛和迈凯伦之间几乎没有差距，至少在单圈速度上是如此。兰多·诺里斯、奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里、马克斯·维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔在排位赛模拟中的差距约为0.06秒。
然而在长距离跑中，力量对比向红牛倾斜。这支位于米尔顿凯恩斯的车队在轮胎衰减管理方面相比迈凯伦尤为高效。维斯塔潘平均每圈比安东内利慢0.83秒，而他的队友哈贾尔则落后1.02秒。与此同时，诺里斯每圈落后1.24秒，皮亚斯特里则落后多达1.40秒。
就目前情况来看，红牛因此在比赛条件下似乎是梅赛德斯最有希望的挑战者。然而，鉴于与领先的梅赛德斯之间存在相当大的差距，数据显示对维斯塔潘而言，拉塞尔可能比安东内利是更现实的目标。
法拉利在卡塔尔是否面临中游集团的竞争？
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利，阿尔维德·林德布拉德，小红牛
评估法拉利的表现要困难得多。这支车队在第二节自由练习中执行了不同的计划，在排位赛模拟上花费了相对较长的时间，随后在练习赛末段才切换到正赛模拟。
然而，法拉利的单圈速度并不令人信服。单圈下来，法拉利落后梅赛德斯超过一秒。这让法拉利更接近小红牛，尽管对红牛的姊妹车队略有优势。
在长距离测试中，刘易斯·汉密尔顿仅完成了三圈，而夏尔·勒克莱尔只跑了两圈。因此，计算出的汉密尔顿每圈1.28秒和勒克莱尔2.18秒的差距几乎没有代表性。
特别是，在如此少的圈数基础上，无法可靠评估更长一段 连续驾驶时段中的实际轮胎退化情况。因此，汉密尔顿相对于迈凯伦车手较小的差距应谨慎对待。
小红牛 统治中游集团，哈斯苦苦挣扎
与前方阵营类似，中游集团的格局也相当清晰。无论是在排位赛模拟还是长距离测试中，小红牛 都是传统中游车队中速度最快的。
在单圈方面，该车队对奥迪保持着约零点二秒的优势。在比赛模拟中，阿尔维德·林德布拉德每圈比安东内利慢1.59秒，而利亚姆·劳森则落后1.79秒。
小红牛之后存在巨大差距：奥迪作为次快的中游车队，每圈已落后领先节奏2.77秒。加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托是唯一在比赛模拟中测试硬胎的车手。
威廉姆斯（+2.97秒）、阿尔派（+3.28秒）和阿斯顿·马丁（+3.32秒）组成下一集团。哈斯表现尤为糟糕，每圈落后3.80秒。只有凯迪拉克更慢，落后4.71秒。
这些差距的规模是周五练习的一个显著特征——无论是安东内利与其他领先车手之间，还是顶级车队与中游车队之间。
为什么卡塔尔强制两停策略可能本来就是必要的
轮胎策略在卡塔尔将再次扮演特别重要的角色。出于安全考虑，单段最多27圈的里程限制已被强制实施。在57圈的比赛距离下，至少需要两次进站。
去年，到比赛周末结束时轮胎退化程度如此之低，以至于如果没有限制，一停策略本来是可行的。然而，今年周五的练习呈现出了相当不同的竞争图景。
在排位模拟中，一些车手仍能在其单段（stint）的第九或第十圈做出个人最快圈。相比之下，在长距离（long run）中，众多车手都苦于严重的轮胎退化。在某些情况下，圈速在十圈内恶化了约两秒。
有趣的是，一些车手在这一关键阶段之后轮胎状况有所恢复，随后圈速得到提升。软胎表现尤其糟糕，奥利弗·贝尔曼和费尔南多·阿隆索等人在赛车模拟中使用了软胎。然而，中性胎也表现出相对较高的退化，平均每圈损失0.18秒。
在博尔托莱托手中，硬胎被证明要稳定得多，退化仅为每圈0.065秒。然而，博尔托莱托是唯一在硬胎配方上提供长距离数据的车手。
随着抓地力水平提高，轮胎退化在周末剩余时间里可能会减少。然而，鉴于周五观察到的高退化水平，即使没有强制进站次数限制，两停策略似乎也很可能出现。就目前情况而言，中性胎和硬胎预计将是首选的正赛轮胎。
detailEn: F1 Qatar GP practice analysis: Kimi Antonelli nearly a second clear of Max Verstappen on long runs
Mercedes dominated Friday’s running in Qatar, with Andrea Kimi Antonelli averaging 0.83s per lap faster than his closest rival in the race simulations

Kimi Antonelli heads into the penultimate race weekend of the 2026 Formula 1 season in Qatar as the early favourite. The reigning world champion dominated Friday practice at the Lusail International Circuit, both over a single lap and in the race simulations. His advantage on the long runs was particularly impressive: his closest challenger, Max Verstappen, was on average 0.83s per lap slower in the adjusted long-run analysis.

Antonelli had already set the fastest time in the opening free practice session, outpacing his team-mate George Russell by 0.507 seconds. Mercedes' dominance continued in the second session, although several incidents and red flags limited the usefulness of the qualifying simulations.

Of the leading teams, only Red Bull and McLaren managed to complete flying laps on the soft tyres. Nevertheless, neither team was able to beat the times set by Mercedes on the mediums. Antonelli topped the timesheets with a 1:23.077, with Russell just over a tenth and a half behind. Lando Norris, the closest challenger to the Mercedes duo, was already nearly half a second adrift.

The competitive picture was even more pronounced in the race simulations. Once differences in tyre compounds and stint lengths were accounted for, Antonelli emerged as comfortably the fastest driver in the field. Even Russell was, on average, 0.90 seconds per lap slower than his team-mate.
Why is Mercedes so dominant in Qatar?

The size of Mercedes' advantage is particularly noteworthy given that the team has not traditionally been known for unleashing the full potential of its car during Friday practice. The works team typically takes a rather conservative approach, particularly when it comes to engine performance.

While differences in fuel loads and engine settings cannot be entirely ruled out on the basis of the practice data, Mercedes’ usual approach provides some grounds for believing its advantage reflects genuine underlying pace, although the extent of that advantage remains uncertain.

A closer look at the sector times instead offers some clues as to where Mercedes' strengths lie. The world championship-winning team is significantly faster to its rivals in the first and third sectors, both of which are characterised by medium- and high-speed corners.

In the opening sector, Mercedes holds an advantage of around three-tenths of a second over Red Bull, its closest challenger. In the final sector, Mercedes gains approximately 0.25s on McLaren and as much as four tenths on Red Bull – despite its rivals running on the softer tyre compound.

Only in the second sector are Red Bull and McLaren able to match Mercedes. However, the soft tyre is likely to offer a particular advantage in this section of the circuit, where tighter, slower corners place greater demands on traction.
Red Bull or McLaren: Who will emerge as Mercedes' closest challenger?

Behind Mercedes, little separates Red Bull and McLaren, at least over a single lap. Lando Norris, Oscar Piastri, Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar were separated by around 0.06s in the qualifying simulations.

Over the long runs, however, the balance of power shifted in Red Bull's favour. The Milton Keynes-based team was particularly effective at managing tyre degradation compared to McLaren. While Verstappen was an average of 0.83 seconds per lap slower than Antonelli, his team-mate Hadjar was 1.02 seconds adrift. Norris, meanwhile, was 1.24 seconds per lap off the pace, with Piastri trailing by as much as 1.40 seconds.

As things stand, Red Bull therefore appears to be Mercedes' most promising challenger in race conditions. Given the considerable deficit to the lead Mercedes, however, the data suggests Russell may be a more realistic target for Verstappen than Antonelli.
Is Ferrari facing a midfield battle in Qatar?
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Arvid Lindblad, Racing Bulls

Assessing Ferrari's performance is considerably more difficult. The Scuderia pursued a different programme during the second free practice session, spending a relatively long time on qualifying simulations before switching to race simulations late in the session.

Ferrari’s single-lap pace, however, was unconvincing. Over a lap, Ferrari was more than a second off Mercedes' pace. That placed the Scuderia closer to Racing Bulls, albeit with a slight advantage over Red Bull's sister team.

In the long runs, Lewis Hamilton completed just three laps, while Charles Leclerc managed only two. Consequently, their calculated deficits of 1.28s per lap for Hamilton and 2.18s for Leclerc are hardly representative.

In particular, actual tyre degradation over a longer stint cannot be reliably assessed on the basis of so few laps. Hamilton's relatively small deficit to the McLaren drivers should therefore be treated with caution.
Racing Bulls dominates the midfield as Haas struggles

A similarly clear-cut picture to that at the front of the field emerged in the midfield. Racing Bulls was comfortably the fastest of the traditional midfield teams, both in the qualifying simulations and over the long runs.

Over a single lap, the team held an advantage of around two tenths of a second over Audi. In the race simulations, Arvid Lindblad was 1.59 seconds per lap slower than Antonelli, while Liam Lawson was 1.79 seconds adrift.

Behind Racing Bulls lies an enormous gap: Audi, the next-fastest midfield team, was already 2.77 seconds per lap off the leading pace. Gabriel Bortoleto was the only driver to trial the hard tyre in the race simulations.

Williams (+2.97s), Alpine (+3.28s) and Aston Martin (+3.32s) form the next group. Haas endured a particularly poor showing, with a deficit of 3.80s per lap. Only Cadillac was slower, trailing by 4.71s.
The sizes of these gaps was a notable feature of Friday's running – both between Antonelli and the other leading drivers, and between the top teams and the midfield.
Why Qatar's mandatory two-stop strategy may have been necessary anyway

Tyre strategy will once again play a particularly important role in Qatar. Due to safety concerns, a maximum stint length of 27 laps has been imposed. With a race distance of 57 laps, at least two pit stops will be required.

Last year, tyre degradation was so low by the end of the race weekend that, a one-stop strategy would have been feasible without the restriction. This year's Friday practice, however, painted a rather different competitive picture.

During the qualifying simulations, some drivers were still able to set personal bests on the ninth or tenth lap of their stints. In the long runs, by contrast, numerous drivers struggled with significant tyre degradation. In some cases, lap times deteriorated by around two seconds within ten laps.

Interestingly, some drivers saw their tyres recover after this critical phase, with lap times subsequently improving. The soft tyre performed particularly poorly and was used in the race simulations by, among others, Oliver Bearman and Fernando Alonso. However, the medium also exhibited relatively high degradation, with an average time loss of 0.18 seconds per lap.

The hard tyre proved considerably more consistent in Bortoleto's hands, with degradation of just 0.065 seconds per lap. However, Bortoleto was the only driver to provide long-run data on the hard compound.

As grip levels improve, tyre degradation is likely to decrease over the remainder of the weekend. Given the high levels of degradation observed on Friday, however, a two-stop strategy appears likely even without the mandatory stint limit. As things stand, the medium and hard compounds are expected to be the preferred race tyres.

items.titleZh: 卡塔尔站轮胎问题加剧：15圈即达100%磨损
items.summaryZh: 倍耐力在卡塔尔大奖赛周五练习后评估是否需要采取更多预防措施，因为最受考验的左前胎在仅15圈后局部磨损已达100%。
items.originalTitle: 100% wear in 15 laps - Qatar tyre issue has got even worse
items.summaryEn: Pirelli is evaluating whether further precautions are needed for the Qatar Grand Prix after Friday practice, as the most heavily used front-left tyres reached 100% wear in localised areas after just 15 laps.
detailZh: 尽管已采用本赛季最高的前轮胎压并设定了最大使用圈数上限，倍耐力仍在评估卡塔尔大奖赛是否需要采取更多预防措施，因为周五练习带来了“一个又一个意外”。
卢赛尔赛道本就是本赛季对轮胎最具挑战性的赛道，但首日赛道运行的数据显示，颗粒化、磨损和性能衰退的程度都高于赛前预期。
据怀疑，这是由于赛道表面风化程度更高，以及2026款赛车下压力降低导致滑动。
在这个每套轮胎设定27圈最大使用圈数、并被广泛讨论的周末，倍耐力已经看到证据：最受考验的左前胎在周五仅运行15圈后，局部区域的磨损就达到了100%。
倍耐力首席工程师西蒙·贝拉表示：“这条赛道每次他们来到这里时给我们带来的惊喜都相当令人印象深刻。”
三种配方轮胎都出现了颗粒化现象——其中在C2和C3配方上尤为严重。这加速了轮胎两个特定区域的磨损——靠近内侧胎肩处，以及最外侧胎肩处。
而正是在这些特定区域，早期分析指出，在练习赛中仅经过15圈高油量运行后，一些磨损指标就已达到100%的水平。
这些因素也导致卡塔尔出现了过去未曾见过的热衰减退化水平——每圈高达0.2秒——这将对策略产生影响，因为车手们将无法像过去那样在长距离阶段（stint）中持续施压。
除此之外，倍耐力还在周五练习赛结束后收回的轮胎橡胶中发现了被碎石割伤的痕迹。
贝拉表示：“我们看到其中一些割痕已经相当深地进入轮胎结构。也因此出现了一次红旗，在这条赛道上，这显然是一个额外的变量，可能在爆胎方面引起我们的关注。”

detailEn: Despite the highest front tyre pressures of the season and a maximum stint length already in place, Pirelli is evaluating if further precautions are needed for the Qatar Grand Prix after Friday practice served up “surprise after surprise.”

The Lusail circuit is already the most challenging of the season for tyres, but the evidence from the first day of track running has shown graining, wear and degradation to be at higher levels than anticipated pre-event.
It is suspected this has been caused by a more weathered track surface and the reduced downforce levels of the 2026 cars that are causing sliding.

On a weekend where there is a much-talked-about 27-lap maximum stint length laid down for each set of tyres, Pirelli has already seen evidence of the most abused front-left sets hitting 100% wear in localised areas after just 15 laps of running on Friday.
Pirelli’s chief engineer Simone Berra said: “It's quite impressive the surprises that this circuit gives to us every time they come here.”

Graining has been encountered on all three compounds - with it particularly aggressive on the C2 and C3. This is accelerating the wear in two specific areas of the tyre - near the inside shoulder and then on the very outside shoulder.
And it is in these specific areas where early analysis has pointed to some wear indicators having hit the 100% level after just 15 laps of high-fuel running in practice.

These elements are also contributing to Qatar producing levels of thermal decay degradation not seen in the past - up to 0.2 seconds per lap - which is going to have an impact on strategies as drivers will not be able to keep pushing on with stints as they have in the past.
On top of all this, Pirelli has also found evidence of gravel cuts in rubber that was returned to it after Friday practice.

Berra said: “We have seen some of them quite deep into the construction. There was also a red flag due to this, and it's something that obviously in a circuit like this, it's an additional variable that can create some attention from our side in terms of punctures.”
Gravel stone cuts discovered after Friday practice last year prompted Pirelli to increase tyre pressures ahead of Saturday running - and a repeat response has not been ruled out right now.
“We are evaluating all the variables,” he said. “If necessary, we will increase the pressure.”

Front pressures are currently at the 29psi set before the weekend, which is the highest they have ever been heading into an event and at the same level Pirelli settled on from Saturday onwards in Qatar last year.
If Pirelli chooses to raise the pressures any more, then they will be the highest they have been in the modern era of F1.
However, Berra is well aware that raising pressures will likely serve to reduce the contact patch of the tyres even more which could potentially increase graining even more.
“That's why I wouldn't increase the pressure if possible,” he said. “But if we have to for integrity reasons, obviously we are going to evaluate it.”
The other action Pirelli is considering in response to the findings about extreme wear of the tyres is reducing the maximum stint length from its current 27 laps.
Berra said that analysis would take place in Pirelli’s laboratory on the tyres used on Friday to see if there are any concerns about their integrity.

“We are going to check them, to section them, and obviously if there is no integrity issue, we will keep the 27 laps in any case because we know that graining level will reduce for the race, and the teams will do much more management to extend the stint length.
“It's an analysis that is ongoing in our laboratory and, with our usual prescription review, we are going to understand if we continue with 27 or not.”

Even if the situation is a marginal one, reducing the stint length may not necessarily be needed because, with degradation in play, Pirelli’s analysis is that it would make no sense for teams to run the maximum distance anyway as it would be too slow.
Instead, with the race distance being 57 laps it is much more logical for teams to split their stints in three equal ones of 19 laps.

However, teams could be forced to shuffle things around based on the timing of safety cars. So even if they headed into the race not intending to run tyres to the maximum distance, they could be tempted to trying to eke out a final 27-lap stint if safety car timing fell that way.
Berra thinks however that the degradation levels seen mean that pace-wise it would not make sense to run for 27 laps - and early safety cars would more likely turn the race into a three-stopper.

items.titleZh: 安东内利包揽卡塔尔周五两节练习最快
items.summaryZh: 安东内利在2026年F1卡塔尔大奖赛周五的两节练习中均领先于梅赛德斯队友拉塞尔，第二节练习两度出示红旗。勒克莱尔表示法拉利速度“非常非常差”。
items.originalTitle: Winners & losers from F1 2026 Qatar GP Friday practice
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli led Mercedes team-mate George Russell in both Friday practice sessions for the 2026 Qatar Grand Prix, with FP2 interrupted by two red flags. Charles Leclerc said Ferrari's pace was "very, very poor".
detailZh: 安东内利在2026年F1卡塔尔大奖赛周五的两节练习中都领先于梅赛德斯队友拉塞尔，其中第二节练习两度因红旗中断。
有些车手比其他车手更挣扎——少数车手在开局几节练习中损失了大量行驶时间——但谁才是卡塔尔周五的赢家与输家？
如果你问勒克莱尔，汉密尔顿在第二节练习中因动力问题把车停到路边，很可能是法拉利最不担心的事！
汉密尔顿在练习中使用的是较旧的引擎，因此勒克莱尔似乎并未因这一问题而不安。更大的问题在于，勒克莱尔认为“速度就是非常非常差”。
从今天早上第一圈到第二节练习赛最后一圈，我们都非常慢，很难搞清楚问题到底出在哪里。
勒克莱尔打滑后更换底板浪费了时间，但这只是分散了对法拉利真正问题的注意力。无论从哪个角度看，这辆车都很慢，他们有一个漫长的夜晚来尝试解决。 - 杰克·贝尼恩
倍耐力的轮胎在卡塔尔赛道上备受折磨——这已使其成为本赛季对轮胎最具挑战性的一站。
卢赛尔赛道因为高速弯角会带来颗粒化、高磨损、高胎体温度以及疲劳风险，加上碎石带来的额外危险，而今年情况比赛前预测的更糟。
风化后的赛道表面变得更加粗糙，再加上2026年的下压力与性能水平，两者共同作用产生了高程度的局部颗粒化，导致某些轮胎组在仅仅15圈后就在局部区域达到100%的磨损。
尽管使用了本赛季最高的胎压，并且规定每组轮胎的最长使用段为27圈，倍耐力今晚仍在进行分析，以确定是否需要在排位赛日之前采取更多措施，以避免正赛中出现任何风险。——乔恩·诺布尔
在连续两个周末未能登上领奖台、此前已锁定两项世界冠军之后，梅赛德斯看起来处于非常有利的位置，有望在这里终结这一小段低谷。
很难指望比这更好的周五了。赛车看起来非常平衡，在所有弯道类型中都表现出色，单圈优势巨大，长距离表现也同样强劲。
两位车手似乎对赛车的感觉相当满意，而所有竞争对手都感到担忧，认为梅赛德斯自成一档。
因此，这对梅赛德斯来说，是长久以来表现最好的一个周末了。——斯科特·米切尔-马尔姆
尽管梅赛德斯认为红牛可能在排位赛中成为其最接近的对手，但目前这与红牛和马克斯·维斯塔潘在最近几场比赛中设定的标准相差甚远。
周五晚上，红牛阵营明显弥漫着不悦的气氛，维斯塔潘抱怨赛车感觉脱节，存在严重的转向问题需要连夜解决，而且总体而言，红牛在赛车平衡方面看起来远未理顺。
技术总监皮埃尔·瓦什并不乐观地认为差距能够显著缩小，因为差距实在太大了。所以目前看来，红牛在周五遭遇了一个令人警醒的日子，这使得他们对本周末剩余时间的期望低于其近期强劲表现本会让其在进入本周末时所抱有的信心。——SMM
你可能会看看小红牛的表现然后想，嗯，像往常一样领跑中游车队，没什么可看的。
但深入剖析一下，这里其实还有更多情况。
它最大的问题是直线速度，但正如利亚姆·劳森所说，那都是“我们能看到也应该能解决的问题”。
他表示，车队在练习赛之间对赛车设置进行了调整，调整幅度在F1中极为罕见；车队领队艾伦·珀曼证实，这次调整主要是为了增加赛车的旋转能力，因为大多数车队都在与转向不足作斗争。
劳森认为：“我们在第一节练习中就已经有一辆相当不错的赛车，现在我们的赛车更快了”，并且车队在长距离跑动中与下一支只使用中性胎的车队（奥迪最接近，但使用的是硬胎）之间有着很大的差距。——JB
加斯利的打滑以及随后赛车陷入沙坑，让他在第二节练习中损失了宝贵的时间，而这一节练习是最能代表排位赛条件的。
这位法国人表示，他“可能本不该冒险”，因为轮胎温度低于工作温度，他压到了路肩，随后失去了对赛车的控制——在此过程中损坏了赛车的底板。
此外，他对赛车调校“并不完全满意”——阿尔派 董事总经理 Steve Nielsen 表示，平衡性“远未达到所需水平”。
考虑到高速性能是 阿尔派 的最大弱点，这条赛道本来就不太可能适合他们，但如今加斯利在进入周六前处境更加被动。——Samarth Kanal
卡马拉周五顺利无碍，这对这位新秀来说是个宽慰，他在主场比赛中经历了 F1 生涯的艰难开局。
在卡塔尔，卡马拉排在哈斯队友奥利·贝尔曼之前，但他的长距离节奏更为重要。
这位巴西车手在第二次练习赛中与贝尔曼不相上下，在他的那一段（stint）里比这位英国人慢了不到十分之一秒。
这看起来是他这次客串出场以来最有用的测试，为他的全赛季F1首秀做准备。——SK
对阿斯顿·马丁来说，这个周末看起来比拉斯维加斯稍好一些，但必须加上一个极大的星号：情况本来就不可能更糟了。
就目前而言，所谓更好也许只是意味着不用和凯迪拉克缠斗。没有长距离跑（long run）可以用来评判这支车队，部分原因是当天最大的问题——这辆车在这样一条容易损坏零件的赛道上似乎并不特别结实。
阿斯顿·马丁选择在诸多干扰下结束当天的工作，以便尽可能修复问题，因为他们在各节练习与排位之间以及期间有大量停摆时间用来尝试修复损伤。
迈克·克拉克预计晚上要用胶水把碳纤维碎片粘回去，兰斯·斯特罗尔有背部问题，这看起来是一个棘手的周末开局，而相对而言，阿斯顿·马丁原本对这个周末抱有略高一些的期望。——SMM
威廉姆斯周五徘徊在第15名左右，两位车手都没能开个好头，卡洛斯·塞恩斯和亚历克斯·阿尔本在第一节练习中都有失误。
塞恩斯的长距离平均速度比阿尔本更快，但两人都远远落后于中游其他车队——我们的分析认为威廉姆斯比次好的车队奥迪慢了将近一秒，也落后于哈斯。
这位西班牙车手表示他未能“完成”自己的单圈。“总是有突然的失控，总是有转向不足，总是有一种可能不适合整圈的平衡，很难把它收尾。”
这对排位赛来说不是好兆头。——天空体育
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli led Mercedes team-mate George Russell in both Friday Formula 1 practice sessions for the 2026 Qatar Grand Prix, including an FP2 that was punctuated by two red flags.
Some drivers struggled more than others - and a few lost considerable running over the opening practice sessions - but who are the winners and losers from Friday in Qatar?
If you ask Charles Leclerc, Lewis Hamilton pulling over to the side of the road with a power issue in FP2 was likely the least of Ferrari's worries!
Hamilton was running an older engine for practice, so Leclerc seemed unperturbed by the issue. The bigger problem is that the "pace has just been very, very poor", reckons Leclerc.
"We were just very slow from the first lap this morning to the last lap in FP2 and it's very difficult to understand what is the outlier."

It didn't help that time was wasted changing Leclerc's floor after a spin, but that just distracted from what is Ferrari's real issue. It's slow by any measure and has a big night to try and fix it. - Jack Benyon
Pirelli’s rubber is taking a battering around the Qatar track - which has sealed its status as the most challenging of the season for tyres.

The Lusail venue delivers graining, high wear, high carcass temperatures because of the fast corners and fatigue risks, plus extra jeopardy caused by gravel stones - and this year things are worse than predicted pre-event.

A combination of the weathered track surface that has got rougher allied to 2026 downforce and performance levels have come together to produce high levels of localised graining that is resulting in some sets reaching 100% wear in localised areas after just 15 laps.

Despite the highest tyre pressures of the season, and a 27-lap maximum stint length for each set having been laid down, Pirelli is conducting analysis tonight to see if even more action needs to be taken ahead of qualifying day to avoid any risk of trouble in the race. - Jon Noble
After two consecutive weekends without a podium finish since wrapping up both its world championships, Mercedes looks in a mega place to end that mini streak here.
It could hardly have hoped for a better Friday. It looks very well balanced, strong in all corner types, and there's a massive one-lap advantage and in the long run too.
Both drivers seem pretty happy with how the car feels, and all of its rivals are worried and feel that Mercedes is in a league of its own.
So this is about as good as any weekend has looked for Mercedes in a long time. - Scott Mitchell-Malm
Though Mercedes thinks Red Bull could emerge as its nearest rival come qualifying, right now this is miles off the standard that Red Bull and Max Verstappen have been setting in recent races.

There was a distinct air of unhappiness from the Red Bull camp on Friday evening, with Verstappen bemoaning a car that feels disconnected, a heavy steering problem needing resolving overnight, and just generally Red Bull not looking nearly as sorted with its car balance.

Technical director Pierre Wache is not optimistic that the gap can be closed significantly because it is so big. So this is looking like at the moment Red Bull suffering a chastening Friday that leaves it with lower hopes for the rest of the weekend than its recent mega form would have had it believing in coming into the weekend. - SMM
You might look at Racing Bulls' performance and think, hmm, leading the midfield as is pretty much usual, nothing to see here.
Peel back the layers and there's quite a lot more going on here.
Its biggest issue is straightline speed, but, as Liam Lawson puts it, that's all "stuff we can see and should be able to fix".

He says the team made a set-up change to an extent that is rarely seen between practice sessions in F1, which team boss Alan Permane confirmed was about adding more rotation into the car with most teams struggling with understeer.

"We already had quite a good car in P1 and now we have an even faster car," reckons Lawson, and the team has a big gap to the next team that only ran the mediums (Audi was closest but on the hards) on long runs. - JB
Gasly’s spin and subsequent beaching cost him valuable time in FP2, the session most representative of qualifying conditions.
The Frenchman said he “should have probably not gone for it” as the tyres were below temperature, he hit the kerbs, and then lost control of the car - damaging the car’s floor in the process.
Furthermore he was “not fully pleased” with the set-up - and Alpine’s managing director Steve Nielsen said the balance is “nowhere near where it needs to be”.
This was never likely to be a great Alpine track given high-speed performance is its biggest weakness but now Gasly is even more on the back foot heading into Saturday. - Samarth Kanal
Camara’s trouble-free Friday will come as a relief to the rookie who endured a rocky start to F1 in his home race.
In Qatar, Camara finished ahead of Haas team-mate Ollie Bearman but his long-run pace is of greater importance.
The Brazilian was right on par with Bearman in FP2, under a tenth slower than the Briton over his stint.
It’s looking like the most useful running yet in this cameo ahead of his full-season F1 debut. - SK
This is looking like a slightly better weekend for Aston Martin than in Las Vegas, but that comes with the extremely big asterisk that it couldn't really be worse.

As it stands, better might just mean not fighting with Cadillac. There are no long runs to be able to judge the team on partly because of the biggest issue of the day, which is that the car didn't seem particularly robust around the challenges of such a parts-breaking circuit.
Aston Martin opted to call it a day with all the disruptions in order to fix what it could, having had a lot of downtime between and during the sessions to try and repair damage.

Mike Krack predicted an evening bonding bits of carbon back together with glue, Lance Stroll has a back problem, and this looks like a tricky start to a weekend that Aston Martin had, in relative terms, slightly higher hopes for. - SMM
Williams hovered around P15 on Friday and neither driver started on the front foot, as both Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon had offs in FP1.
Sainz’s long run was faster than Albon’s on average, but the pair are well behind the rest of the midfield - our analysis putting Williams almost a second behind next-best team Audi and behind Haas.
The Spaniard said he failed to “close” his laps. “There's always snaps, always understeer, there's always a balance that maybe doesn't suit the whole lap and it's difficult to close it.”
That doesn’t bode well for qualifying. - SK

items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc spun early in FP2 at the Formula 1 Qatar Grand Prix, attributing it to a general lack of grip in the SF-26 on what he called a "very, very difficult" day for Ferrari. He and team-mate Lewis Hamilton could only manage seventh and eighth in FP2, a full second adrift of Mercedes' leader Kimi Antonelli.
detailZh: 勒克莱尔解释卡塔尔站练习赛打滑：法拉利经历"缓慢"而痛苦的一天
法拉利在F1卡塔尔大奖赛首日速度挣扎后仍有大量工作要做
勒克莱尔称F1卡塔尔大奖赛第二节练习对法拉利而言"非常、非常艰难"，他早早的打滑是SF-26整体缺乏抓地力的表现。
在第一节练习中开局平淡之后，勒克莱尔与队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿在第二节练习中仅列第七和第八，落后梅赛德斯领跑的基米·安东内利整整一秒。
勒克莱尔的情况雪上加霜，在练习赛初期从7号弯出弯时遭遇剧烈打转，导致底板受损，不得不在练习赛中途更换部件。
勒克莱尔解释说，他其实在练习赛早些时候就因卢赛尔赛道著名的高路肩而损坏了底板，随后冲入砾石区造成的进一步损伤迫使法拉利完全更换底板。
“这真是一节非常、非常艰难的练习赛。”勒克莱尔解释道，“最快圈速我想是我在二练的第一圈，之后我们真的无法再提升。当然，我们在中性胎上没跑多少圈，因为之后不得不停下来维修，因为我在路肩上弄坏了底板。”
“在我失控之后情况可能变得更糟了，所以我们决定更换底板，这让我们损失了不少时间。”
法拉利体育总监迭戈·约韦尔诺解释道：“打转之后，底板出现了明显的损坏。我们从数据上也看到了这一点，于是让他停下来。损坏无法修复，所以我们更换了底板。之后，赛车周围还有一些小的损伤，但都不严重。”
不过，勒克莱尔并没有把底板损坏当作车队缺乏速度的借口，汉密尔顿同样报告车尾抓地力不足、速度不佳也印证了这一点。“说实话，这甚至不是我们慢的原因。从今天早上第一圈到第二节练习赛最后一圈，我们就是非常慢，很难理解问题出在哪里，”勒克莱尔承认道。
卢赛尔摩托车赛道拥有众多高下压力弯角，本应是法拉利SF-26能够具备竞争力的赛道，因此车队现在正仔细研究数据，以便在一夜之间找到解决方案。
“我真的认为存在一个我们需要找出的异常点，”勒克莱尔补充道。“目前我们还没能准确找到它，但我们会继续努力，争取明天扭转局面。总的来说，速度一直非常非常差。低油量、高油量，通常高油量是我们的强项，但今天完全没有速度。我真的不知道我们还能在哪些方面做出显著改进，从而彻底扭转局面。”
法拉利在延长后的练习赛末段还因动力单元故障损失了汉密尔顿，但由于这位七届世界冠军在练习赛中使用的是一台较旧的动力单元，之后过夜才会换上一台较新的动力单元，所以他的故障并不太令人担忧，勒克莱尔表示：“我不认为这在后续会是个问题，因为我们用的是相当旧的动力单元。显然有车停下来从来都不好受，但在赛季末这样的阶段，以我们自由练习的设定来说，这只是时间问题。”
虽然伊奥韦尔诺不想在周五练习赛常年笼罩的“战争迷雾”下过度解读梅赛德斯优势令人担忧的程度，但他确实承认，法拉利还有很多东西需要分析。
他指出：“今天梅赛德斯看起来特别快，不仅比我们快，也比其他人快。不管是什么原因，他们在这里的套件表现甚至比赛季其余时间更好，或者也许他们在方案、动力设置、燃油负载等方面做出了不同的选择。”
“他们显然比所有其他人领先一步。我们会更深入地研究手头的数据，数据并不多，并努力弄清楚明天我们能在哪些方面做得更好。”
detailEn: Charles Leclerc explains Qatar GP practice spin after painfully "slow" day for Ferrari
Ferrari has its work cut out after the first day of Formula 1's Qatar Grand Prix after struggling for pace
Charles Leclerc rued a "very, very difficult" FP2 for Ferrari at the Formula 1 Qatar Grand Prix, with his early spin the symptom of a general lack of grip in the SF-26.
Having already gotten off to a quiet start in FP1, Leclerc and team-mate Lewis Hamilton could only manage seventh and eighth in FP2, a full second adrift of Mercedes' leader Kimi Antonelli.
Not helping his cause, Leclerc suffered a violent spin exiting Turn 7 in the early stages of the session, sustaining floor damage that warranted a parts change mid-session.

Leclerc explained that he had actually already damaged his floor earlier in the session over Lusail's notoriously high kerbs, and further damage following his excursion through the gravel trap forced Ferrari to change the floor entirely.

"It's been just a very, very difficult session." Leclerc explained. "The best lap time was I think my first lap in FP2 and after that we could never really improve. Of course, we didn't do that many laps on the medium tyres because then we had to stop to repair because of the floor damage I got on the kerbs.
"After I lost the car it probably made it even worse, so we just decided to change the floor which cost us quite a bit of time."

Ferrari sporting director Diego Ioverno explained: "After the spin there was clear damage on the floor. We saw it also from numbers, and we told him to stop. It was not repairable, so we replaced the floor. After that, there were still some small damages around the car, but nothing major."

Leclerc didn't call in his floor damage as an excuse for the team's lack of pace, though, as also evidenced by Hamilton's poor pace as he reported a lack of rear grip. "To be honest, this is not even the reason why we were slow. We were just very slow from the first lap this morning to the last lap in FP2 and it's very difficult to understand what the outlier is," Leclerc acknowledged.

With its many high downforce corners, motorcycle circuit Lusail is a track that the Ferrari SF-26 could have been expected to be competitive on, so the team is now poring over the data to find solutions overnight.

"I really think there's an outlier that we need to find," Leclerc added. "At the moment, we just didn't quite put our finger on it, but we'll keep working in order to turn the situation around tomorrow. Overall, the pace has just been very, very poor. Low fuel, high fuel, normally high fuel is our strength, but today, there was just no pace at all. I don't really have an idea of what we can do significantly better that will turn the situation upside down."

Ferrari also lost Hamilton to a power unit failure in the closing stages of an extended practice session, but as the seven-time world champion was running an older power unit for practice before turning to a fresher one overnight, his failure was not much of a concern, said Leclerc: "I don't think that this is a worry going forward because we're running with quite old power units. It's never nice to obviously have a car stop, but towards the end of the season like this, with our free practice set-up, it was a matter of time."

While Ioverno didn't want to read too much into the worrying extent of Mercedes' superiority given the fog of war that perennially clouds Friday practice, he did admit there is a lot for the Scuderia to analyse.

"Today Mercedes seems particularly quick, not only compared to us, but also compared to the others," he noted. "It can be whatever reason that their package here is performing even better than in the remainder of the season, or maybe they've made different choices in terms of plan, power settings, fuel load, whatsoever.
"They are apparently a step in front of all the others. We will look deeper into the data that we have, which is not so much, and try to understand what we can do better tomorrow."

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen feels a “disconnect” as Red Bull looks to solve “massive limitation” in Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 维斯塔潘感到与红牛车队之间有一种“脱节”的感觉，车队正在努力解决在卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛中存在的“巨大局限”
维斯塔潘表示，在卡塔尔，梅赛德斯车队领先优势明显，但他补充说，其中一半的差距可能已经是因为红牛车队没有达到它想要的车辆平衡状态
在维斯塔潘在拉斯维加斯的胜利一周后，这个周末将面临一个完全不同的挑战。虽然沿着大道的街道赛道以长直道和慢速弯道为特点，但卢塞尔国际赛道几乎完全相反。
除了6号弯——赛道上唯一的慢速弯道之外，赛道主要特点是高速弯道，根据维斯塔潘的说法，这并不是红牛车队在本赛季擅长的领域。因此，他在媒体日预测这个周末将会更加困难，而且这种感觉在第一和第二次练习赛中得到了加强。
维斯塔潘在周五的比赛中以第五名的成绩结束，落后于基米·安东内利半秒，附加条件是梅赛德斯车手在倍耐力中胎上设置了最快圈速，部分原因是红旗的影响。
“这是一条非常不同的赛道，相当独特。这是一条很难做对事情的赛道，所以我希望我们能做得更好，”维斯塔潘在卡塔尔的第二次练习赛后说。
“我认为与梅赛德斯之间的差距非常大，所以我们需要有很大的进步。但我想，如果我们不能从我们这边得到更好的平衡，那可能已经是我们失去的半圈时间了。”
在周五的比赛中，维斯塔潘再次遇到了几个问题。他在车队无线电中抱怨说方向盘感觉“非常沉重”，而小红牛22的整体平衡也不够好。
“我们还没有达到预期的目标，”他说。“目前只是稍微有些脱节，所以我们需要尝试调整平衡，看看我们是否能够调整正确。让我们看看我们是否可以为明天解决这个问题。”
红牛技术总监皮埃尔·瓦切表示，在卡塔尔解决这些问题是一个困难的平衡行为。车队需要解决他所说的‘巨大限制’——高速弯角的前左轮胎，在卡塔尔承受特别高的负荷——同时不使赛车在弯道入口处不稳定。
“我认为通过在高速和中速弯角处实施巨大的前限制来解决这个问题，而不影响弯道入口，这是关键。他们[梅赛德斯]能够做到这一点，而我们还有工作要做才能实现这一点，”瓦切说。
对于红牛来说，好消息是车队之前已经多次扭转了困难的星期五，但瓦切表示，他并不一定对在卡塔尔有类似的转变有信心。
“不，但我认为这就是我的感觉。这并不意味着我们会实现[它]，”他说。“我希望我们能像往常一样实现同样的转变，但我感觉我们……差距很大。差距非常大，这使得我们很难实现这一点。”
这意味着，根据周五的测试，红牛的战斗似乎主要是与麦克拉伦队，这也是他们在 constructors' championship 中争夺第三名的对手。
“我们能做的最好的就是排在麦克拉伦队前面，或者希望更好。很难说，但根据我们所了解的，我同意梅赛德斯在前面，而他们后面，我们与麦克拉伦队在一起，我们后面可能是法拉利。”
梅赛德斯在直线和高速度弯道上的表现都很强劲，这些弯道是卢塞尔赛道的特征，但维斯塔潘最后强调，红牛需要首先关注自己，只有当它改善了自身的赛车平衡后，才能关注竞争。”
“他们可能在直线上的速度很快，也许他们的平衡性也比我们目前的好一些。我们自己并不满意，当你自己不满意的时候，很难达到同样的水平，”这位四次世界冠军说。
detailEn: Max Verstappen feels a “disconnect” as Red Bull looks to solve “massive limitation” in Qatar GP practice
Verstappen says Mercedes is particularly far ahead in Qatar, but adds that half of that gap may already be down to Red Bull not having its own car balance where it wants it to be

A week after Max Verstappen's victory in Las Vegas, a completely different challenge awaits this weekend. While the street circuit along the Strip was characterised by long straights interspersed with slow corners, the Lusail International Circuit is almost the exact opposite.

Apart from Turn 6 – the only slow corner on the circuit – the track predominantly features high-speed corners, and according to Verstappen, that is not exactly an area in which Red Bull excels this season. The Dutchman therefore predicted during media day that this weekend would be more difficult, and that impression was reinforced during the first two practice sessions.

Verstappen ended Friday's running in fifth place, half a second behind Kimi Antonelli, with the added caveat that the Mercedes drivers set their fastest lap times on Pirelli’s medium tyres, partly due to the red flags.
“It's a very different track, quite a unique track. It's not an easy track to get things right, so I hope we can do a little bit better,” Verstappen said after the second practice session in Qatar.

“I think the gap to Mercedes is very big, so we need a big jump for that. But I think already from our side, if we can't get that balance more together, that's probably already half of the lap time that we're losing.”

During Friday's sessions, Verstappen once again encountered several problems. He complained over the team radio that the steering felt “very heavy”, while the overall balance of the RB22 is not good enough either.

“It's not where we want it to be yet,” he said. “It's just a bit too disconnected at the moment, so we need to try and bring the balance together and see if we can get it right. Let’s see if we can fix that for tomorrow.”

Red Bull technical director Pierre Wache says that solving these issues is a difficult balancing act in Qatar. The team needs to address what he calls a ‘massive limitation’ in high-speed corners – the front-left tyre, which is subjected to particularly high loads in Qatar – without making the car unstable on corner entry.

“I think it’s key to fix the balance issue that we can have here by having a massive front limitation in the high-speed and medium-speed corners without compromising the corner entry. They [Mercedes] are able to do that and we have work to do to achieve that,” Wache said.
The good news for Red Bull is that the team has turned difficult Fridays around on several occasions before, but Wache indicated that he is not necessarily confident of a similar turnaround in Qatar.

“No, but I think that’s just what I feel. It doesn't mean what we will achieve [it],” he said. “I hope that we will achieve the same turnaround as normal, but I don't feel that we... The gap is big. The gap is very big and that makes it difficult for us to achieve that.”
It means that, judging by Friday's running, Red Bull's battle appears to be primarily with McLaren, the team it is also fighting for third place in the constructors' championship.

“The best we can have is to be in front of McLaren or hopefully even better. It's difficult to say, but from what we read, I agree that Mercedes is in front and that behind them, we are together with McLaren, and after us maybe Ferrari.”

Mercedes appears strong both on the straights and through the many high-speed corners that characterise the Lusail circuit, but Verstappen concluded by stressing that Red Bull needs to focus primarily on itself and can only look at the competition once it has improved its own car balance.

“They're probably quick on the straights, but maybe they also have a bit of a nicer balance than what we have at the moment. We are not happy ourselves, so when you're not happy yourself, it's very hard to get the same number,” the four-time world champion said.

detailZh: 诺里斯：卡塔尔站梅赛德斯“处于另一个水平”
领跑者安东内利对迈凯伦和红牛车手组合握有接近半秒的优势，法拉利则深陷困境
卡塔尔大奖赛周五的两节练习赛均以新科世界冠军安东内利与其梅赛德斯队友拉塞尔紧咬的一二名收尾，但在这条高速赛道上，其他人都无法匹配他们的惊人速度。
在代表性较弱、于白天较热时段进行的第一节练习赛中，拉塞尔落后安东内利半秒，但在第二节练习赛中，他把与另一位梅赛德斯车手的差距缩小到约0.4秒。
兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里驾驶的迈凯伦赛车，以及马克斯·维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔驾驶的红牛赛车，在第一节练习赛中大幅缩小了此前巨大的差距，但第二节练习赛结束时仍比安东内利慢了约半秒。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔驾驶的法拉利赛车也稍微接近了一些，但第二节练习赛结束时仍落后超过一秒。
“我认为除了梅赛德斯之外，我们相对于其他所有人的表现看起来都还可以，”诺里斯赛后说道。“与其他所有人相比，梅赛德斯就是处在另一个水平。这总体上说明了我们落后了多少。
“并不是说有什么东西在这里对他们特别有效。我的意思是，你可以清楚地看到，如果他们在这里很快，出于同样的原因，他们在很多其他地方也很快。所以我认为这更多是让我们认识到自己相对于他们所处的位置。”
诺里斯不祥地预测，迈凯伦无法通过连夜调校工作来弥补差距。
“我认为差距大概就是那样，”他说，“我得说每圈大约零点七秒。我们达不到那个水平。”
维斯塔潘对于连夜在自己的赛车上解锁一些东西的前景略为乐观，他观察到——正如今年周五经常出现的情况——小红牛22的前后轴感觉“脱节”。更多的平衡或许还能带来零点几秒的提升，甚至可能达到半秒。
“他们（梅赛德斯）在直道上可能很快，但平衡性或许也比我们目前的状态稍好一些，”他说，“我们自己都不满意，所以当你自己都不满意时，很难跑出同样的数字。”
卢赛尔赛道只有一个慢弯，这或许能解释法拉利的重大差距。两辆梅赛德斯W17在赛道上最后一段高速连续右弯中显得特别快，在那里，平衡和下压力能让你在14号弯出口不冲出赛道边缘。
勒克莱尔则表示，法拉利仍在琢磨这个差距有多少是因为SF-26意外地慢，又有多少是因为梅赛德斯超出了预期。
“从今天上午的第一圈到FP2的最后一圈，我们都非常慢，很难理解异常点在哪里，”他说。
“我认为不只是我们，对所有人来说都是如此，尤其是与梅赛德斯相比，他们似乎……他们总是拥有最好的赛车，但现在差距大到了我们未曾预料的地步。”
法拉利体育总监迭戈·约韦尔诺表示认同：“今天梅赛德斯看起来特别快，不仅比我们快，也比其他车队快。”
“原因可能有很多——他们在这里的套件表现比本赛季其余时间更好，或者他们在计划方面做出了不同的选择。不管是什么，动力、设定、车重、载油量，无论什么。他们很强。
“他们显然比其他所有车队都领先一步。我们明天看吧，在周末剩余的时间里，他们的表现会如何。”
detailEn: Lando Norris: Mercedes “at a different level” in Qatar
Pacesetter Kimi Antonelli had close to half a second in hand over the McLaren and Red Bull pairings, with Ferrari in real trouble

Both practice sessions on Friday at the Formula 1 Qatar Grand Prix ended with new world champion Kimi Antonelli and his Mercedes team-mate George Russell in a closely matched 1-2, but nobody else could match their blistering pace around this high-speed circuit.
Russell was half a second off Antonelli in the less representative first session, held during hotter daylight hours, but he found the best part of four tenths relative to the other Mercedes in FP2.

The McLarens of Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri, along with the Red Bulls of Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar, made some inroads into what had been a yawning gap in FP1, but still ended the second session in the order of half a second slower than Antonelli.
The Ferraris of Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc also got a little closer but still ended FP2 over a second away.
“I think we look okay relative to everyone, except Mercedes,” said Norris afterwards. “Mercedes are just at a different level comparing to everyone else. It shows just in general how far off we are.

“It's not like something works better for them here. I mean, you can just clearly see if they're quick here, they're quick in a lot of other places for the same reason. So I think it's more a realisation of where we stand relative to them.”
Ominously, Norris predicted that McLaren would not be able to make up the deficit through overnight set-up work.
“I think the gap's probably right,” he said. “I'd say about seven tenths a lap. We're not getting close to that.”

Verstappen was slightly more optimistic about the prospects of unlocking something in his car overnight, observing that – as has been so often the case on Fridays this year – the RB22’s front and rear axles felt “disconnected”. More balance could yet yield a couple of tenths, if not half a second.

“They [Mercedes] are probably quick on the straight, but also maybe a bit nicer balance than what we have at the moment,” he said. “We are not happy ourselves, so when you're not happy yourself, it's very hard to get the same number.”

The Lusail track has just one slow corner, which perhaps accounts for Ferrari’s major deficit. Both Mercedes W17s seemed particularly quick around the fast sequence of right-handers towards the end of the lap, where balance and downforce are rewarded by not skittering wide over the exit kerb of Turn 14.
Leclerc, for his part, said Ferrari was still wondering how much of the deficit was the SF-26 being unexpectedly slow, or the Mercedes exceeding expectations.
“We were just very slow from the first lap this morning to the last lap in FP2 and it's very difficult to understand what is the outlier,” he said.
“I think not only for us but for everybody, particularly comparing to Mercedes, that seems to be... They always kind of have the best car, but now it's to an extent that we did not expect.”
“Today Mercedes seems particularly quick, not only compared to us, but also compared to the others,” agreed Ferrari sporting director Diego Ioverno.

“It can be whatever reason – that their package here is performing even better than in the remainder of the season, or maybe they've done different choices in terms of plan. Whatever it is, power, setting, weight of the car, fuel load, whatever. They are strong.
“They are apparently a step in front of all the others. We'll see tomorrow, in the remainder of the weekend, how they will perform.”
